## Installation

Build the verified repository revision from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aspose-note-foss/Aspose.Note-FOSS-for-Python.git
cd Aspose.Note-FOSS-for-Python
git checkout 6d97a522a9ed24708687911f1aabb76e2dea2da7
mvn clean install
```

This path requires JDK unknown+ and Maven. The source build and the minimal example
below were verified together at revision `6d97a522a9ed24708687911f1aabb76e2dea2da7`.
